document: Knowledge-grounded cyclic-peptide candidates v1 — αvβ6 (and PD-L1 approach)
principle: Knowledge fixes the binding pharmacophore (hard); the LLM/diversity explores the free flanking space for novelty + developability; structure/physics/FTO gate. This is the integration of LLM + knowledge, not a pure LLM.

avb6.pharmacophore_fixed_by_knowledge: RGD tripeptide (Asp carboxylate -> MIDAS metal; non-substitutable) in the extended RGDL context, presented on a head-to-tail macrocycle with a D-Pro + N-methyl conformational lock. Validated class: Trivehexin c[YRGDLAYp(NMe)K], avebehexin cyclo(FRGDLAFp(NMe)K), A20FMDV2 (...RGDLxxL...).
avb6.design_rule: cyclo( cap - R-G-D-L - x1 - x2 - (D-Pro) - (N-methyl)X ); require RGD+Asp+dPro+NMe; diversify cap/x1/x2/NMe AWAY from Trivehexin(Y..A.Y)/avebehexin(F..A.F) for composition-of-matter novelty while preserving the mechanism.
avb6.honesty: These are DESIGN HYPOTHESES that carry the validated pharmacophore (unlike the old 0/12-RGD set) — NOT validated binders. They still require: (1) docking vs the αvβ6 MIDAS pocket, (2) FTO vs the Trivehexin/avebehexin genus (they sit in that patented chemotype — the real squeeze the review flags), (3) wet-lab SPR. 'More promising' = carries the mechanism + the lock, with a per-candidate rationale; not 'will bind'.

candidates.rationale: RGDL core; Phe/Ser/Trp flanks distinct from Trivehexin YRGDLAY
aromatic Trp cap for β6 selectivity pocket; Thr/Phe flanks novel
His flank adds a polar contact; NMeLeu lock variant
His cap + basic NMeLys for solubility; Trp retained for β6
RGDL-I toward the extended RGDLxxL/I high-affinity class
shifted cyclization register; Gln/Ser polar face, novel topology
extra D-Leu cap for added rigidity/protease resistance
RGDLxI + Trp; Tyr cap but I/W interior distinct from Trivehexin
acidic NMeGlu to modulate charge/PK; flanks near-avebehexin -> FTO-watch
Lys flank for renal-clearance tuning (kidney is the dose-limiting organ)

next_gates: dock vs αvβ6 MIDAS pocket (rank by pose/affinity)
then synthesize the pruned, scored, novel subset

pdl1.position: PD-L1 is a discontinuous PPI surface — no linear motif, so I do NOT hand-write 'validated' PD-L1 sequences (that would be fabrication). Honest path: template on the known macrocyclic binder scaffolds (WL12; BMS-986229 class; dmp10 disulfide-directed) and GATE by docking vs the PD-L1 interface. Deliverable = a structure-gated generation run, not an inspectable sequence list.
pdl1.pushback: The review says PD-L1 'cannot be ruled in' by sequence — true — but it is MORE designable than 'just dock': the BMS macrocyclic-peptide and WL12 chemotypes give concrete scaffold priors to condition generation on. The right move is scaffold-constrained generation + docking, which the knowledge-grounded pipeline supports.
